slides.title: Every generation: the years to buy and avoid.
slides.body: I've owned a 2002, a 2007, a 2016 and now a 2024. Here's what the sources say about each generation. Swipe.

slides.title: Careful with 1990–94 V6s.
slides.body: Toyota said its 3VZ-E head-gasket failures were mostly limited to trucks built 1/90–10/94.
IH8MUD regulars rate 1999–2000 the best years, a '99 with the E-locker above all.

slides.title: Skip 2003–05 V6s. Buy 2006 on.
slides.body: Early V6 head gaskets fail more than average. Late-2006 V6s get the revised gasket, and the 2006-on V8s are the better buys.

slides.title: Late is great.
slides.body: Autotrader says buy a late fifth gen, preferably 2020–24. 2020 made Toyota Safety Sense and CarPlay standard.

end.title: Which generation is yours?
